card.title: Admit You’re Hurt
card.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

mechanism: A asks for B's disappointment before admitting the same supermarket grief over a canceled birthday dinner.
confusable: Unlike freely sharing sadness, A must require the other admission before giving their own.
comparison: D112-a joins B's crying admission with a candle-shopping confession; D112-b changes a formal complaint into a personal hurt statement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
